page.overview:
What is Look At Myself?

Look At Myself (also known as "Shadows of the Cross") is an unreleased song by Metallica that was recorded during the Presidio sessions. The full song is currently unreleased and only some parts of the song are available to the public. Some of them are featured in the documentary, "Some Kind of Monster" and some in Metallica's studio videos.
